verdict.rationale: CSC's entity management product claims it uses AI to produce instant summaries of key document content and to route documents to entities and folders automatically. That is a real, first-party form of AI-generated insight from the user's own data, but it is limited to document summarization and routing. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or recommendations across entity/compliance data, proactive suggestions, any detail on how the AI summaries work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
